rapport_notes: Thorough and genuinely engaged in digging into the spin-bike's specs and disassembly needs, then patiently handled a detailed pricing/policy Q&A.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move?' asked immediately after confirming a convenient time, before any logistics questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised the spin bike as a concern; rep asked model, weight, whether it could be disassembled, then researched and confirmed the exact spec (350 lbs) before proceeding — genuine multi-turn follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: No-worries damage coverage ($2,000, waiver for heavy items) was explained, but no rate-commit, window, beats-it, self-prep, or feel-fair lines were used, and no explicit close was attempted ('save the quote... I will call back').

top_strength: Dug two full layers into the one real concern raised (the spin bike) — researching the exact model online to confirm it was liftable within policy, which is exactly the kind of follow-through the rubric rewards.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee and Meet Your Mover were never mentioned, and the call ended without an explicit close ask despite clear interest — a 'would you like to lock this in today?' was the natural next line.
